description: This file defines the AddressFormat class within the Opencart Admin Model Localisation namespace. It contains methods for managing address formats in the OpenCart system, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving address format data.

classes.name: AddressFormat
classes.description: A model class for handling address format data in the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: addAddressFormat
methods.description: Inserts a new address format into the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: editAddressFormat
methods.description: Updates an existing address format identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteAddressFormat
methods.description: Deletes an address format from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: getAddressFormat
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific address format by ID.

methods.name: getAddressFormats
methods.description: Fetches multiple address formats, supporting pagination via start and limit.

methods.name: getTotalAddressFormats
methods.description: Returns the total number of address formats available.
